content.text:
The researcher wants uni_owns_option_to_licence instead of company_owns_uni_academic_use. I need to counter - I can accept the option to licence but would prefer option to assign, which gives us more control. Let me trade: accept uni_owns_option_to_assign (better than option to licence for us, worse than company owns) and keep everything else. That's one field change. I can also keep the 60-day review they accepted.

Actually, let me think about what I need: we need to deploy results in our product. uni_owns_option_to_assign gives us the ability to take ownership if needed, which is better for CRA certification. 

I'll limit myself to changing just the ip field to uni_owns_option_to_assign, keeping exclusivity at 24 months since that matters, and accept their background IP clarification as my trade-off for this round.
